items.title: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers

items.title: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
items.summary: While other social platforms have focused on restricting teens' access to AI chatbots, Pinterest is addressing the AI content filling their feeds.

items.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the gap with Nvidia in the AI chip race
